These four synthetic files are from firecrawl/anydoc's MIT-licensed test corpus.
Source: https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc/tree/main/tests/fixtures
They contain generated examples, not user documents. See LICENSE.anydoc.
Chinese document, image, PDF and recovery fixtures are generated locally by
scripts/web_fixtures.py; those are not downloaded from third parties.

Upstream snapshot: 261fc257d17c3eab0f673be31c408fd9fdc2171a.
chinese.doc is generated with the upstream MIT CFB/FIB builder and synthetic
GBK Chinese text. chinese.ppt replaces one UTF-16 title with an equally sized
synthetic Chinese title, preserving the upstream binary structure.
